name: lightningcss
description: A CSS parser, transformer, and minifier written in Rust

scripts.wasm:build: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p lightningcss_node && wasm-opt target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/lightningcss_node.wasm --asyncify --pass-arg=asyncify-imports@env.await_promise_sync -Oz -o wasm/lightningcss_node.wasm && node scripts/build-wasm.js
scripts.wasm:build-release: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p lightningcss_node --release && wasm-opt target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/lightningcss_node.wasm --asyncify --pass-arg=asyncify-imports@env.await_promise_sync -Oz -o wasm/lightningcss_node.wasm && node scripts/build-wasm.js
scripts.build-ast: cargo run --example schema --features jsonschema && node scripts/build-ast.js
